lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: If a room filled with smoke, would you get up and *leave?*

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: You think you would. Watch this.
lines.say: You think you would... Watch this.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: This man came here to earn twenty dollars. All he has to do is sit and wait.

lines.speaker: copycat
lines.text: Twenty dollars just to sit here? *Easy.*
lines.say: Twenty dollars, just to sit here? Easy.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: What he does not know is that everyone else in this room *works for me.*
lines.say: What he does not know, is that everyone else in this room... works for me.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: I pay them to do one thing. Stay *calm,* whatever happens.
lines.say: I pay them to do one thing. Stay calm... whatever happens.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: Now I let *smoke* into the room.
lines.say: Now... I let smoke into the room.

lines.speaker: copycat
lines.text: Nobody else looks worried. So it must be fine.
lines.say: Nobody else looks worried... So, it must be fine.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: See what he did? He did not look at the smoke. He looked at *the people.*
lines.say: See what he did? He did not look at the smoke. He looked... at the people.
